question_variants: why does one brand outperform another
sql:
SELECT p.brand,
  COUNT(*) AS items_sold,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(p.retail_price), 2) AS avg_price_point,
  ROUND(AVG(p.retail_price - p.cost), 2) AS avg_margin,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(oi.status = 'Returned') / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC
report: A brand revenue gap has three candidate drivers: units sold, price point, and returns. Pull all three in one query so the comparison can attribute the difference instead of just stating it.
